---
title: "E313: Initial stack symbol not in Γ"
description: "With a declared stack alphabet, `initial stack Z` must use one of its symbols."
---

<!-- Generated by `delta gen-docs`. Do not edit. -->

With a declared stack alphabet, `initial stack Z` must use one of its symbols.

## Example

```delta error
pda P (initial stack Z) {
  stack A
  start q0
  q0 -a, A → ε-> q0
}
```
